guide.verdict: Easiest: Single merchant, merchant-generated token (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Multi-merchant app via OAuth (agent default) (app review).

composio.note: Clover is in Composio's 'Bring your own OAuth app' list. Create the auth config with your own App ID and App Secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio offers no managed OAuth app for Clover, so you must register your own app in the Clover Developer Dashboard and give Composio its App ID and App Secret.
reasons: No managed Clover app in Composio
Users see your app name instead of Composio on the consent screen
Dedicated rate-limit quota and your own scopes
Production needs an approved developer account and OAuth tokens

prerequisites.title: Global developer account with owner role
prerequisites.detail: Create a global developer account; only an owner can view account settings and accept the Developer Agreement.

prerequisites.title: Identity and business documents
prerequisites.detail: Clover verifies individual and corporate information and runs an OFAC check. Expect passport or driver's license, proof of home address, and for companies proof of business address and EIN or tax ID.

prerequisites.title: Sandbox build and test
prerequisites.detail: Create and test the app on the sandbox first. Sandbox needs no account approval.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms
prerequisites.detail: A privacy policy and terms of service or EULA are required and checked against Clover legal guidelines.

steps.title: Create global developer account
steps.detail: Sign up and use an owner role. Set the account type to Individual or Business.

steps.title: Build and test the app in sandbox
steps.detail: Create the app in the Developer Dashboard, select REST Client Web, and enable REST Configuration to reveal the Site URL.

steps.title: Submit production developer account
steps.detail: Enter identity details and upload any requested documents. Respond to Clover document requests within 10 business days.
inputs: EIN or tax ID for companies

steps.title: Wait for account verification
steps.detail: Clover gives no fixed timeline. Contact Developer Relations if it takes long.

steps.title: Recreate app in production dashboard
steps.detail: Log in to the production dashboard, create the app and set the Site URL. Note the App ID and App Secret.
steps.done_when: App ID and App Secret in hand

steps.title: Prepare redirect and permissions config
steps.detail: Draft the permission list and check that the redirect URI is a subpath of the Site URL with matching domain and scheme. The Composio callback cannot be verified by you, so route it through your own domain proxy.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI matches the registered Site URL

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your own App ID and App Secret.

steps.title: Record videos and write listing
steps.detail: Record the functional video and any payment flow videos (30 seconds to 3 minutes each). Complete the listing details.

steps.title: Submit for approval
steps.detail: Click Submit for Approval on the checklist, or submit the app for approval per Clover's flow.

steps.title: Wait for app review
steps.detail: Timelines vary. Contact Developer Relations if review runs long.

steps.title: Have merchant generate token
steps.detail: Ask the merchant to generate an API token from their Clover Dashboard and store it per merchant.

traps.title: Concurrent limits cap the number of in-progress API requests
traps.detail: Concurrent limits cap the number of in-progress API requests an app can make at the same time; a request beyond the limit receives a 429 error.

traps.title: A 429 Too Many Requests error is returned when
traps.detail: A 429 Too Many Requests error is returned when an app's API requests exceed the rate limits.

traps.title: Each payment flow video must be between 30 seconds
traps.detail: Each payment flow video must be between 30 seconds and 3 minutes long.

traps.title: Merchant API tokens are sandbox-only for approval
traps.detail: Production review requires OAuth tokens for merchant data, not merchant API tokens allowed in sandbox. A token-based build will not pass app approval.

traps.title: Access tokens expire in 30 minutes
traps.detail: You must refresh with the refresh_token. Apps created before October 2023 using legacy tokens must migrate.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: The redirect_uri must be a subpath of the Site URL with the same domain and scheme. Composio's callback domain cannot be verified by you, so proxy through your own domain.

traps.title: New permissions require reinstall
traps.detail: Merchants must uninstall and reinstall the app for added permissions to take effect. Plan scopes up front.

traps.title: Account needed per country or region
traps.detail: You need a separate production developer account for each country or region.

traps.title: Uninstall invalidates the code
traps.detail: If the merchant uninstalls the app, the authorization code is immediately invalidated.

traps.title: Token endpoint takes JSON body
traps.detail: Send client_id, client_secret and code in the POST body as JSON, not query parameters.

blockers.symptom: Documents requested by Clover by email
blockers.what_it_means: Clover needs more verification information for your developer account.
blockers.what_to_do: Upload within 10 business days to the secure Clover Box or the application may be rejected.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare a checklist of required documents.

blockers.what_it_means: Your app exceeded Clover REST API rate limits.
blockers.what_to_do: Back off, and request a higher limit from Developer Relations with app ID, merchant volume and use case.
blockers.agent_can_help: Add retry logic and draft the request.

blockers.symptom: App is not visible to merchants in the Dashboard
blockers.what_it_means: Merchants cannot be linked to your app in the Dashboard unless it is published.
blockers.what_to_do: Get the app approved and published, or use a merchant-generated token for a single merchant.

open_questions: How long do account and app approvals take? Clover publishes no number; ask Clover Developer Relations.
Does a non-public OAuth app for several merchants need full app approval to install for merchants outside your company? Confirm with Developer Relations.
Does approval differ for general REST apps versus semi-integrated POS apps? Much of the docs cover semi-integrations; confirm with Developer Relations.
Where is the Clover developer docs home? No official URL was provided in the dossier.
